contexts.text: The river, in the garden () = wisdom; the first river thence = good and truth; the second, the Knowledge of all things which are of good and truth, or of love and faith, which are of the internal man; the third = reason; the fourth = knowledge, which is of the external man. All are from wisdom; and this is from love and faith in the Lord. AC 658:end.
A river out of Eden = wisdom from love.
The Most Ancients... compared wisdom, and the things of wisdom, to rivers. In like manner in the Prophets. Illustrated.
They added the waters and rivers by which man was to be irrigated, by which they meant the things which caused his increase.
The things of the first river relate to the will; those of the second, to the understanding.

To him who would be wise from the world... his river Euphrates = all his Scientific, which is condemned; his second river, where Asshur is, = insane ratiocination, whence are Falsities; his third river, where Cush is, = the derivative principles of evil and falsity, which are the Knowledges of his faith; his fourth = the derivative wisdom, which in the Word is called magic Illustrated.
By these rivers are described in the Word passim the boundaries of Canaan. AC 4454:end.
Spirits who inflow in a fluviatile way.

From the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates () = the extension of spiritual and of celestial things; to the river of Egypt = the extension of spiritual things; to the river Euphrates = the extension of celestial things. Explained.
Rivers, etc. () = spiritual goods, among which was its root. Explained.
To place the right hand in the rivers () = strength in the Knowledges of truth.
Aram Naharaim, or Syria of the rivers () = the Knowledges of truth, because rivers = intelligence, which is of the Knowledges of truth.
The river () = the Word; the waters which cause everything to live = the Divine truths which are in it. AE 179:7.
An inundating stream () = falsity thus overflowing.

(Jacob) passed over the river () = a state where is conjunction. The river, here, the Euphrates, = conjunction with the Divine, because it was the boundary of Canaan on that side... As Jacob was now entering Canaan, this river was his first boundary, and thus = conjunction...
Thus the rivers which bounded Canaan (were representative according to their situation).
(Jacob) made them pass over the river () = further insinuation. Explained.
Rivers, and fountains of waters () = intelligence and wisdom from the Word.
Assyria and the waters of the river () = ratiocination from these scientifics against the good of life and truth of faith.

(Pharaoh dreamed that) he was standing by the river () = from boundary to boundary. The river, here, the river of Egypt, or Nile, = a boundary. The reason a river = a boundary, is that the great rivers, Euphrates, Jordan, and Nile, were ultimate boundaries of Canaan. (Continued. See Nile.)
Out of the river () = in the boundary.
On the bank of the river () = in the boundaries.
The river on whose bank ascended every tree of food () = the things of intelligence and wisdom.
The affections and thoughts (then) appeared like a river round about, and the subject of thought in the midst encompassed by that river, which extended thence in all directions.
In the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the plain of the desert () = Knowledges of good and truth for them. AE 239:7. AE 455:20.
Water as a flood () = falsities from evil, and the reasonings thence.
The river shall stink () = aversion for it. The river, here, the river of Egypt turned into blood, = truth falsified. AC 7320. AC 7346.
See River. SE 3176. AE 514:10. AE 518:4.
The river shall bring forth frogs () = reasonings from those falsities.
Only in the river shall they survive () = that they should remain with falsities where these are.
Thou driedst up rivers of strength () = to dissipate the more potent falsities.
The river (of Egypt) = falsity.
In his will like the hidden current of a river...
For all the rivers which were boundaries of Canaan = the first and last things (or the primes and ultimates) of His Kingdom.
The rivers () = the things of intelligence, which are from the truths of faith.
A stream of sulphur () = falsities from the evils of the love of self and of the world. (See River, at AC 2446:2.)
Rivers = falsities.
The river of desolations () = Falsity reigning everywhere.
From the desert even to the river () = from the delight of the Sensuous even to the good and truth of the Rational. (For the Euphrates is meant.)
Unto the sea and unto the river () = to interior truths and goods.
The boundaries of Canaan, which were rivers and seas, = the ultimates in his Kingdom. References.
I make the rivers a wilderness () = to vastate truths themselves.
Rivers of desolations () = truths of doctrine completely desolated. ( = where are no truths. AE 410:6.)
It fell upon a third part of the rivers () = all truths completely falsified. Rivers = truths in abundance. Illustrated. AE 518.

Poured his vial upon the rivers () = influx into the understanding with them... Rivers = truths in abundance which are of service to the rational man, thus to the understanding, for doctrine and life.
A pure river of the water of life bright as crystal () = the Divine truth of the Word in abundance translucent from its spiritual sense. AR 933.
Like a stream of ideas...
The words (of angelic speech) are flowing, into which many consonants are not admitted, because they impede the stream... as, now, I am not allowed to write flumen, but fluvium.
There was the likeness of a river, full of copious ideas.

Influx is as it were a river of general affections, or continuous rivers inflowing... All in this river, or rivers, are affected according to their genius... in this common river it acts with all variety... Thus all and each within this common river of Heaven, which is solely of affections... I spoke with the Angels while I was in such a river...
These rivers of general affections are in every degree... They are circumstanced like an atmospheric river... like the wind blowing, and man knows not whence it comes, and whither it goes.
Rivers = intelligence which is from truths. AE 405:47.
The river () = Divine truth. ( = intelligence. AE 430:7.)
The river shall be dried up () = no doctrine of truth, and thence no intelligence. AE 654:49.
That rivers = the things of intelligence. References.
Rivers = truths of doctrine; and, in the opposite, falsities.
Rivers = falsities and the ratiocinations from them.
Peace as a river () = in abundance.
The Church is called a land of rivers of water (), because rivers of water = doctrinals of truth.
He sendeth springs into the rivers () = intelligence thence. AE 483:7.
The river = the first boundary...
Rivers () = Own intelligence.
Rivers = intelligence. AE 481:2. AE 513:5.
To open rivers () = to give intelligence.
The fountain and the floods () = the falsities of doctrine, which are from Own intelligence. The rivers of strength = the derivative confirmed principles of falsity.
When thou passest... through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee () = that ratiocinations from falsities against truths (shall not enter and corrupt). AE 518:33.
I make the rivers a wilderness () = to deprive the rational man (of truths), whence there is no longer intelligence. AE 730:7.

Rivers = the understanding of truth, also intelligence, because waters = truths, and the understanding is the receptacle and complex of Truths, as a river is of waters; and because thought from the understanding, which is intelligence, is like a stream of truth. AE 518:3. AE 518:4. Illustrated.
Rivers in the solitude () = the intelligence of truth where it was not before. AE 650:36.
Rivers of water = the understanding of truth.
The river () = intelligence from the reception of Divine truth... ( = intelligence and wisdom. AE 629:8).
To send out his roots by the river () = the extension of intelligence from the spiritual man into the natural.
Planted by the river, and waters () = Divine truth inflowing, whence is intelligence.
The influx of Divine truth, and thence of intelligence, is described by the river which went out of Eden to water the garden...
The increase of intelligence is signified by its rivers running about his plant ().
The power of the Lord even to ultimates... is signified by setting His right hand in the rivers. AE 684:22.
The two rivers which formed boundaries of Canaan were Euphrates and Jordan.
He opened the rock... rivers ran in the dry places ()... Rivers = intelligence and wisdom thence.
The rivers, and the sea () = all things of the Church, because they = its ultimates.

That the Word, or the Divine truth for the Church, shall not perish, is signified by, There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God... it shall not be changed (). A river, here, has the like signification as a fountain, namely, the Word; because its streams, which = truths, are spoken of.
The rivers of Egypt () = the Knowledges and apperceptions of truth, because... the natural man (Egypt) has Knowledge and apperception, as the spiritual man has intelligence.
I will make the rivers dry [land] () = no longer the Knowledge and apperception of truth. AE 654:40.
I will make the rivers islands () = that intelligence will perish.
In the opposite sense, rivers = the understanding of falsity, and ratiocination from Own intelligence, which is for falsities against truths. Illustrated.
Whose land the rivers have spoiled (): rivers = the falsities which are of Own intelligence.

The stream had gone over our soul (): the stream = ratiocination from these falsities against truths, (which) would have destroyed the spiritual life, which man receives through truths and a life according to them.
The great river (; ) = the influx of spiritual things into rational ones.
The waters of the river, strong and many, the king of Asshur () = reasonings from mere fallacies and falsities.
The rivers of Egypt shall be diminished and dried up () = that all things of natural intelligence will perish.
The rivers of Egypt () = the intelligence of the natural man from scientifics which are from a spiritual origin...
The river () = Own intelligence.
What hast thou to do with the way of Assyria, to drink the waters of the river? () = ratiocinations thence, whence are falsities of faith.
For seas and rivers are the ultimates of Heaven; and ultimates = all things.
He maketh rivers into a wilderness () = intelligence from the understanding of truth, and also of the Word as to its interior sense, devastated by means of falsities from evil.
I will open rivers upon the cliff's () = intelligence from spiritual truths.
The Euphrates is called the great river, from the intelligence which man has from the Rational; for a river = intelligence...
Fountains = the truths of the Word; and rivers () = the intelligence thence.
The river out of Eden = doctrine...
An inundating stream () = ratiocination from falsities.
